monitoring.title: Request Monitoring
monitoring.subtitle: Track model requests, accounts, channels, and estimated cost here. Model requests are not the same as business requests; task counts are estimated and for reference only.
monitoring.coverage_warning_title: Some historical raw events were deleted
monitoring.coverage_warning_current: Before filters are applied, the current time range includes {{deleted}} archived events that are no longer available as raw rows.
monitoring.coverage_warning_comparison: Before filters are applied, the comparison time range includes {{deleted}} archived events that are no longer available as raw rows.
monitoring.coverage_warning_rolling: Before filters are applied, the rolling 30-minute window includes {{deleted}} archived events that are no longer available as raw rows.
monitoring.coverage_warning_drilldown: Before filters are applied, the drilldown preview range includes {{deleted}} archived events that are no longer available as raw rows.
monitoring.coverage_warning_auxiliary: Before filters are applied, an additional requested range includes {{deleted}} archived events that are no longer available as raw rows.
monitoring.coverage_warning_limited: Permanent derived data keeps supported totals available, but some requested raw-only metrics are incomplete.
monitoring.coverage_warning_derived: All requested metrics are available from retained raw events or permanent derived data.
monitoring.database_maintenance_hint_body: Historical request queries may be slower or time out until offline maintenance completes.
monitoring.database_maintenance_long_range_hint: Long time ranges can be especially expensive while this warning is present.
monitoring.console_subtitle: Track call volume, success and failure, token structure, and spend by account within the selected time range, with a live table that behaves more like a request log console.
monitoring.custom_range_required: Select both start and end times.
monitoring.custom_range_invalid: End time cannot be earlier than start time.
monitoring.search_placeholder: Search account, label, model, channel, source, API key, or request path
monitoring.active_filters_hint: {{count}} filters active, {{rows}} calls match the current scope.
monitoring.auth_health_meta: Credential metadata is mapped back to usage details
monitoring.usage_disabled_body: Request Monitoring depends on Manager Server or compatible usage data. Enable usage statistics and verify Manager Server is running to populate runtime metrics here.
monitoring.request_monitoring_disabled_body: CPA Manager Plus is not currently reading request records. Enable request monitoring in CPA Manager Plus Configuration when you need this page.
monitoring.request_monitoring_service_unavailable_b: Request monitoring is unavailable from this Manager Server. Check setup, request-record reading status, and the bound CPA connection.
monitoring.request_monitoring_not_configured_body: Request monitoring is available only from the Manager Server-hosted panel after setup. CPA panel mode does not support usage-statistics features.
monitoring.empty_diagnostics_body: If CPA has requests but this page is still empty, confirm request monitoring is enabled, Manager Server is running, and only one Manager Server is reading usage from the same CPA.
monitoring.zero_token_notice_body: There are {{count}} zero-token model calls in the current range ({{models}}). These models are usually not billed purely by tokens, so cost remains a partial estimate.
monitoring.estimated_cost_hint: Only covers models with configured pricing and token-based billing.
monitoring.estimated_cost_missing: Model pricing is not configured yet.
monitoring.zero_token_model_calls_hint: Useful for spotting image or other non-pure-token billing models.
monitoring.token_signal_desc: Separates input, output, reasoning, and cache reuse so spend structure and cache efficiency are visible together.
monitoring.metric_scope_note: Top metrics count model requests in the current filter. Task counts are estimated by grouping request time, source, and account.
monitoring.requests_trend_desc: Aggregates requests and token volume by {{granularity}} to expose bursts, rhythm changes, and cost pressure.
monitoring.model_mix_desc: Highlights the dominant models in the current filter scope so hotspots are obvious.
monitoring.hourly_requests_desc: Shows where demand concentrates within a day.
monitoring.hourly_tokens_desc: Shows which hours absorb the most token volume for capacity and spend analysis.
monitoring.channel_table_desc: Summarizes request volume, success rate, and latency by channel so you can see which channels are stable.
monitoring.model_table_desc: Tracks request volume, success rate, token usage, and latency by model.
monitoring.failure_table_desc: Surfaces the noisiest failing sources and channels first, so account or route issues are visible early.
monitoring.realtime_health_desc: Connection status, credential enablement, and recent failure signals update with the current filter window.
monitoring.account_models_desc: Model-level spend and call distribution for {{account}} in the current scope.
monitoring.api_key_summary_desc: Aggregates calls, success/failure, total tokens, and estimated cost by client API key in the current filter scope. Expand a row to inspect token structure and model usage.
monitoring.api_key_summary_description: These keys are caller/client API keys. Aliases are preferred when available; expanded rows show input, output, cached tokens, and per-model calls and spend for that key.
monitoring.account_overview_title_hint: Real-time per-account roll-up of calls, tokens and cost within the current filter scope; expand for model details and quota usage.
monitoring.account_overview_description: Real-time per-account roll-up of calls, success/failure, token structure and total cost within the current filter scope. Expand a row to inspect model details and quota usage.
monitoring.account_overview_health_hint: Based on request statistics in the current filter scope.
monitoring.account_overview_status_hint: Current account enabled state summarized from linked login files.
monitoring.account_overview_success_rate_hint: Successful calls divided by total calls in the current filter scope.
monitoring.codex_inspection_desc: Checks selected Codex and xAI credentials for operational health, quota evidence, and disabled-state recovery. Delete, disable, and enable actions are executed only after confirmation.
monitoring.codex_inspection_mode_server_unavailable: Server inspection requires the Manager Server-hosted panel and an available CPA connection.
monitoring.codex_inspection_mode_local_desc: Runs through the local flow behind the current browser connection and depends on this connection and browser session. Use it for quick checks on the current device.
monitoring.codex_inspection_mode_server_desc: Runs the credential health check on Manager Server. It supports schedules, background runs, and history, making it better for batch checks.
monitoring.codex_inspection_logs_desc: Probe and execution logs are streamed in realtime and can be collapsed after the run completes.
monitoring.codex_inspection_logs_filter_empty: No logs match the selected level.

monitoring.observed_from_usage_headers_at: Historical record from recent usage response headers at {{time}}.
monitoring.codex_inspection_sampled_hint: Random sampling is enabled, so only sampled accounts generate suggested actions.

monitoring.codex_inspection_reason_healthy: Quota is healthy; no action is needed
monitoring.codex_inspection_reason_quota_threshold: Quota usage exceeded the configured threshold
monitoring.codex_inspection_reason_recovered: Quota recovered; enable the credential again
monitoring.xai_inspection_reason_free_quota_disable: xAI free usage is exhausted; disable this account
xAI free usage is exhausted; keep the account disabled
monitoring.xai_inspection_reason_spending_limit_dis: xAI spending or credit limit was reached; disable this account
xAI spending or credit limit was reached; keep the account disabled
monitoring.xai_inspection_reason_auth_invalid: xAI OAuth credentials are invalid; sign in again
monitoring.xai_inspection_reason_entitlement_disabl: xAI subscription or entitlement is insufficient; disable and review the account
monitoring.xai_inspection_reason_entitlement_review: xAI subscription or entitlement is insufficient and requires review

monitoring.xai_inspection_reason_upstream_error: The xAI service or network is temporarily unavailable; run the check again later

monitoring.xai_inspection_reason_unknown: The check could not determine the cause; the account will not be changed automatically

monitoring.xai_inspection_reason_inference_healthy: A real xAI inference request completed successfully
monitoring.xai_inspection_reason_inference_manual_d: A real xAI inference request completed successfully, but this account was not disabled by inspection; review it before enabling manually

monitoring.xai_inspection_reason_billing_healthy: Billing data was retrieved successfully. Model invocation was not verified
monitoring.xai_inspection_reason_official_api_healt: The official xAI API identity is reachable, but billing and model invocation were not verified

monitoring.xai_inspection_reason_inference_request_: The xAI inference request did not complete; check the network or try again later. The account will not be changed automatically
monitoring.xai_inspection_evidence_basic_healthy: billing or official API identity healthy

monitoring.xai_inspection_log_server_missing_auth_i: xAI account inspection skipped because auth_index is missing

monitoring.codex_inspection_settings_xai_model_hint: Choose a model available to the inspected credentials.
monitoring.codex_inspection_settings_xai_prompt_hin: Health depends on request success; response text is not evaluated.
